description:
Yong-Hee, whose only dream was to live happily with the grandmother who raised her, suddenly found a scumbag calling her "Dragon Head" with the words, "Dragon~! Head ! Aren't you coming over quickly ?!" Chan-Young, who is pretty on the outside but hateful the moment he opens his mouth, uses his innate scumbag nature to turn Yong-Hee's life upside down. "You've really messed with me." Yong-Hee, who was helplessly wavering, was unaware that she was about to leave, turning her back on the fresh scent of roses.
